name: George M Mills
residence: Goshen County (in an August 17, 2026, Torrington Telegram questionnaire he wrote that his family had lived in the county for more than eight years)
occupation: The Torrington Telegram reported his 2026 candidate statement that he has more than 31 years of law-enforcement experience in corrections, detention, and patrol, including 12 years as a corporal with the Natrona County Sheriff's Office.
military: In the same Torrington Telegram questionnaire he wrote that he was deployed to northern Iraq and Turkey with the 10th Special Forces Group (A) during the original Gulf War and Operation Provide Comfort, and later served as a corporal with the 1/49th Field Artillery and 2/300 Field Artillery.
background: George M. Mills ran in the 2026 Republican primary for Goshen County sheriff. In a Torrington Telegram candidate questionnaire published August 17, 2026, he wrote that he has more than 31 years of law-enforcement experience in corrections, detention, and patrol, including 12 years as a corporal with the Natrona County Sheriff's Office, that his family had lived in Goshen County for more than eight years and moved a registered cattle herd to the county, and that he was deployed to northern Iraq and Turkey with the 10th Special Forces Group (A) during the original Gulf War and Operation Provide Comfort. He lost the August 18, 2026, Republican primary to Herb Irons.
